_comment: What the public data bundle (scripts/ops/build_public_bundle.sh) leaves out, and why. The script and tests/test_public_bundle.py both read this file. A language is in the bundle only if it is listed in core_languages or theme_tier_languages. Everything else is out by default, and the three languages in withheld_languages are named so a test can check that no path for them can slip in.

withheld_languages.ar: Arabic is held back from the site itself.
withheld_languages.fa: Persian is served on the site, but the terms for passing the texts on are not cleared.
withheld_languages.ur: Urdu is served on the site, but the terms for passing the texts on are not cleared.

theme_tier_languages.it: Italian: Dante, Commedia (Inferno, Purgatorio, Paradiso). Project Gutenberg #1000, public domain in the United States; only the text travels, not Gutenberg's header or trademark text.
theme_tier_languages.fro: Old French: Chanson de Roland, from the French Wikisource transcription of Joseph Bedier's edition (Bedier died 1938, public domain).
theme_tier_languages.gmh: Middle High German: Nibelungenlied, Karl Bartsch's 1887 Schulausgabe scanned on the Internet Archive (Bartsch died 1888, public domain).

theme_tier_note: Theme-tier languages have texts, translations that pass the licence rule, passage-index windows, descriptions, vectors, names rows and map rows. They have no lemma cache, word index or bigram table, so none is looked for or bundled.

never_paths.tesseraev6.sql: The PostgreSQL dump (users, search logs, reviews).
never_paths.data/job_uploads: Files uploaded by users of the site.
never_paths.cache/scholarship: Cached answers from third-party scholarly services whose terms do not allow passing them on.
never_paths.data/citation_index: Index of sentences quoted from journal articles. The sentences are publisher text, so the index stays out until its terms are reviewed.
never_paths.models: Model weights are downloaded from their publishers by the install steps.
never_paths.tesserae-models: The trained Theme Search reader. Its training data has not been confirmed to be entirely open, so it is not shared.
never_paths.data/inverted_index/syntax_latin.db: Parsed-sentence databases built from treebanks with mixed terms. Not bundled.
never_paths.data/translations/manifest.json: Lists translations that are withheld. The bundle carries its own MANIFEST.tsv.

translation_licence._comment: A translation file travels only if its license field starts with one of these and mentions none of the forbidden words. Anything else stays on the server.

commentary_licence._comment: A commentary file travels when every licence it states (license, and license_translation where present) is public domain or Creative Commons (BY, BY-SA, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, CC0, in any wording that names them). A missing, empty, 'unknown' or 'None' licence, or a notice forbidding republication, keeps the file out.
